name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Avant le § 1 - Am 5
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: -1c. Calls for the EU’s annual budget to encourage the development potential of each country to be harnessed in full, through public investment, by supporting and modernising productive and strategic sectors, promoting sovereignty of the Member States, in particular in the food and energy sectors, investing in and boosting the efficiency of public services, creating jobs with rights and promoting full employment, supporting small and medium sized enterprises and local commerce, fighting to eradicate poverty, combating social exclusion and inequalities, conserving and restoring ecosystems, mitigating and adapting to climate change, and seeking to forge external relations rooted in solidarity, cooperation, mutual respect and peace;
